meeting.title: Modal weekly sync — semantic layer
meeting.summary: Weekly implementation sync with Modal. Reviewed semantic layer progress; Theo to draft the first metric definitions, Dara to provision the read-only Snowflake service account, Priya to nominate the pilot group.
action_items: Theo to draft the first ten metric definitions in dbt yml by Friday
Dara to provision read-only Snowflake service account by end of next week
Priya to send pilot group list
key_decisions: Start the semantic layer with the compute-usage billing marts
meeting.notes: Row-level security parked for a later phase. Pilot group likely the platform team first.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Thanks for making time again. Last week we got the dbt repo compiling in Quarry, so this week is about metrics.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: Right. Our marts are in decent shape, the compute-usage billing models especially.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Perfect starting point. I'll draft the first ten metric definitions in the dbt yml and share them by Friday for your review.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: Great. On our side, warehouse access is still the gap — you're on my personal credentials right now, which won't fly with security.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Agreed, we need the dedicated account before we open this beyond you two.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: I'll get the read-only service account provisioned on our Snowflake by end of next week. I need platform team sign-off but that's a formality.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Once that lands, who do we let in first?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Usually a small pilot group — five to eight people who live in the data anyway.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: That's the platform team. I'll send you the pilot group list with names and emails.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Great. Anything on row-level security? You mentioned it in the kickoff.

transcript.speaker: Dara Okafor
transcript.text: We should think about row-level security at some point, but honestly it's not a launch blocker. Let's park it.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Parked. So: metrics draft from me by Friday, service account from you by end of next week, pilot list from Priya.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Works for us. Same time next week?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Same time next week. Thanks both.
